facts.text: John, say please, say thanks, and don't throw the car. Dinner is at seven.
facts.why: Ray Embrey does not say this in the film. His advice is about apologising publicly and going to prison, and the throwing-the-car line is invented.
facts.fix: John, dinner is at seven. Come as you are, and say thanks to Mary.
